notes: Read both civil-rights units, full preceding equal-opportunity context, all ten candidates and the review. Named President Obama's administration in every reported action. Split preventing youth bullying from supporting LGBT youth. Restored the description of putting America back to work as Job One and the explicit attribution of the listed presidential actions as reflecting Democrats' equal-opportunity principle.

claims.claim_text: Putting the United States back to work is characterized as the highest priority.
President Obama's administration hosted the first White House Conference on Bullying Prevention.
Commitment to continue work preventing vicious bullying of young people.
President Obama ended Don't Ask, Don't Tell in full cooperation with U.S. military leadership.
President Obama enacted the Matthew Shepard and James Byrd Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act.
President Obama ensured that same-sex couples could visit each other in hospitals.

President Obama's listed actions are presented as reflecting Democrats' belief that all Americans deserve equal chances to pursue happiness, earn a living, live safely, serve their country and care for loved ones.
President Obama's administration said immigration's definition of family includes LGBT relationships to protect binational families threatened with deportation.
